matching_rules.how_it_works: Each template has 'triggers' (keywords/phrases). If a customer message contains ANY trigger from a template's list, that template fires. If multiple templates match, the one with the MOST matched keywords wins. If nothing matches confidently, escalate to human — never guess.
matching_rules.matching_type: case-insensitive substring / fuzzy keyword match (no LLM reasoning, no semantic guessing)
matching_rules.min_confidence: At least 1 strong keyword match required. Generic words alone (e.g. 'price', 'have') should NOT fire a template without a product keyword alongside them.

Hi, thank you for getting in touch.

I would have loved to. However, the Norom Pak Sondesh that we make can be transported from one city to another only through a reliable cold-chain courier service. Unfortunately, we haven't yet found a partner who can offer this at a reasonable cost.

So for now, we're unable to ship our sondesh outside Delhi NCR — we do not deliver to Bangalore or other cities at this time. We'd love to, though, and will certainly start as soon as we find a dependable cold-chain delivery option.

That said, many of our regular customers who live in different parts of India and the world do buy our sondesh by asking friends or family travelling from Delhi NCR to carry a few boxes for them. We're happy to deliver the order to their home, office, hotel, or any other convenient location before they travel.
